pick_word.subtitle: Search the room skillfully! Don't give up!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: According to this article, Brendan's prints were all over the Wilson High security system...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And Howard and Hector's prints were on the fireworks used to start the blaze.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh... If it's in the paper, it must be true. I guess they really did do it...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Of course they did it, Amanda! That's why they got in trouble! They... Wait a second...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This says, 'The fire began at approximately 11:00 PM on the night in question...'

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I thought the boys set the fire immediately after we split up, but this says the fire started much later that night.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't know about Brendan or Hector, but I know for a fact that Howard `couldn't` have set the blaze.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know about Brendan or Hector, but I know for a fact that Howard [color=#3b78e2][i]couldn't[/i][/color] have set the blaze.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yes, I do! At 11:00 PM, Howard and I were watching a movie together!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So... Maybe they didn't start the fire after all?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's hope so, Amanda. Tomorrow, we should go tell Judge Tigh what we've found out.
The next day, at the Courthouse...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: That's a nice story you've got there, Missy, but as far as I'm concerned that's all it is.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But I'm `telling` you... One of the people you've accused of the crime didn't do it!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]telling[/i][/color] you... One of the people you've accused of the crime didn't do it!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Listen, girlie, people `tell` me a lot of things.
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, girlie, people [color=#e23b3b][i]tell[/i][/color] me a lot of things.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: They say, 'No! I didn't do it, your Honor!'

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: They say, 'No! I have rights, your Honor!'

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: They say, 'If you think this dress makes me look so fat, why'd you even marry me, your Honor?'

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... They do?

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Sure, she does... I mean... Err, they do.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Anyhow, my point is, this system doesn't care what people `say.` It cares what people can `prove.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyhow, my point is, this system doesn't care what people [color=#e23b3b][i]say.[/i][/color] It cares what people can [color=#e23b3b][i]prove.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And as far as I'm concerned, all the `evidence` I've seen tells me your boyfriend is guiltier than a fox in a henhouse.
nodes.text_bbcode: And as far as I'm concerned, all the [color=#e23b3b][i]evidence[/i][/color] I've seen tells me your boyfriend is guiltier than a fox in a henhouse.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And even if he didn't set the fire personally, nothing you've told me exonerates either of his two buddies.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: That makes him an `accomplice.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That makes him an [color=#e23b3b][i]accomplice.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Do you ladies understand what I'm telling you?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That Howard eats chickens?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'll explain the metaphor later, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: But I'll tell you what... If you girls find evidence that `all three` of your friends did not set the fire, I'll reconsider the terms of their incarceration.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I'll tell you what... If you girls find evidence that [color=#e23b3b][i]all three[/i][/color] of your friends did not set the fire, I'll reconsider the terms of their incarceration.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Fine! If you want proof, we'll get you proof. Then you'll see you've convicted innocent guys!
Linda pushes Amanda out of the office.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What?! Why?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Because Boot Camp isn't a place where you get to try on lots of different fun boots.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It isn't?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No! It's a place they send you for punishment after you burn down a library.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But... But Hector would never do something like that. You're just being mean!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm not being mean, Amanda! See? It's right here in the paper.
Linda picks up a copy of the Centerscore `Herald.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Linda picks up a copy of the Centerscore [b]Herald.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But... Why would I worry?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Because Boot Camp isn't a place where you get to try on lots of different fun boots.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It isn't?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, Boot Camp is a place they send you for punishment when you take a Prank War too far and burn down the Wilson High library.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But... But Hector would never do something like that!
Linda picks up a copy of the Centerscore Herald.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Unfortunately, he would, Amanda. See, it's right here in the paper.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We can't afford to get held up at the soccer challenge and fall behind in the race.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Ha! What's that I hear?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Are you Centerscore losers giving up already?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Alexei, what are you doing here? This is a Centerscore practice!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I dropped by to check out the competition... Only it turns out there isn't any.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Maybe the rest of your squad should've thought twice before getting all 'fired up' over the big event.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Ha! Get it? I said 'fired up'... And you're going to lose the Crosstown Races because your fireworks-friendly teammates started a fire. Priceless!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Keep it real, dweebs.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Linda, are you okay? You look angry!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: GRR!
Later that night...
Linda paces the room as Amanda composes a letter at her desk. As she writes, Amanda periodically stops to sniff a beautiful bouquet of `marigolds.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Linda paces the room as Amanda composes a letter at her desk. As she writes, Amanda periodically stops to sniff a beautiful bouquet of [b]marigolds.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I just don't get it, Amanda! How could they do this to us? Howard, Brendan, and Hector knew we needed their help to beat Wilson in the Crosstown Races...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But then they had to go and take the silly Prank War way too far!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It just doesn't make sense! Why would they burn down a school library?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Maybe they really wanted to go to Boot Camp?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Why would anyone `want` to go to Boot Camp?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why would anyone [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to go to Boot Camp?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: To try on all the great boots!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector told me that he was going to try on over a hundred different kinds of cowboy boots and exactly one pair of galoshes.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Amanda, Hector...

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Hey! We're doing the best we can here! It's not like any of us have any experience playing soccer.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: And besides, did you ever stop to consider that the problem might be with the coaching?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No way! I think Linda is a great coach! She let me wear shoes with super cute metal bumps on the bottom.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Those are cleats, Amanda. You have to wear them when you play soccer!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, I still think they're neat!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Listen, Linda, my point is that yelling at us isn't going to turn us into better athletes.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: We are what we are... Second stringers.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Focus, guys... The Crosstown Races are a series of events that will take our team from one side of Centerscore to the other.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Soccer is one of those events.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know you all hoped you'd be participating in the Crosstown Races in other ways...

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: You got that right.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But without Brendan, Hector, and Howard on our team, we have to make sacrifices, okay?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And I'm sorry I lost my temper. None of you deserve to be yelled at. I know you're all doing the best you can.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Of course, we are. But so are you. Coaching a team of second stringers can't exactly be easy.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: The Crosstown Races are a series of events that will take our team from one side of Centerscore to the other. Soccer is one of those events.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know you all hoped you'd be participating in the Crosstown Races in other ways...

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: You got that right.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But without Brendan, Hector, and Howard on our team, we have to make sacrifices, okay?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Today, we're going to concentrate on Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And we still have to investigate Hector's alibi.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We still have to investigate Howard's alibi.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We still have to investigate Brendan's alibi.
The next day...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay, so where are we?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And we still have to investigate Hector's alibi.

nodes.text: We still have to investigate Howard's alibi.

The next day...

nodes.text: Okay, so where are we?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay. Brendan, it is.

nodes.speaker: Amanda

nodes.text: And we still have to investigate Hector's alibi.

nodes.text: We still have to investigate Howard's alibi.

nodes.text: We still have to investigate Brendan's alibi.
The next day...

nodes.text: Okay, so where are we?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay. Brendan, it is.

nodes.speaker: Amanda

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay. Hector, it is.
Later that afternoon...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay Amanda, we have to find proof that Brendan, Howard, and Hector were nowhere near Wilson High when the library burned down.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Unfortunately, time is tight.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: The Crosstown Races are in three days. Factoring in practices, we'll have exactly three opportunities to search for evidence.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Who should we investigate first?
But not quite perfect. Try again to access the special bonus scene!

nodes.text_bbcode: Be sure to check out our new Premium Content, [b]Hector's Guide to Girls[/b]! Enroll in Hector's seminar, and you'll find out how to score a date the Surviving High School way!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: My bailiff tells me you have proof that those three Centerscore High School students didn't burn down the Wilson High library.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I sure do!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Okay, let's hear it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, the fire in the library started at 11:00 PM.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But according to this logsheet, Brendan was playing a computer game, Warscrewdriver: Online, at that exact time.
Judge Tigh examines the logsheet.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Hmm... This does seems pretty conclusive... What about the other suspects?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, Howard was watching a movie with me at the time of the fire.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And your proof...?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I've got a photograph of us together in the movie theater. It was taken at exactly 11:02 PM on the night in question.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Hmm... These surveillance photos look very professional. Who took these?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard's sisters. And see this? They even made sure to include a newspaper with the correct date.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Well okay... I suppose this evidence lets Howard off the hook.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: But what about the last student?

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Hector still needs an alibi. He was photographed by a traffic camera on the Wilson side of town fifteen minutes before the fire started.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, that's... I mean...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: I'm waiting. Do you have any proof that would exonerate Hector?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, not as such, but... The thing is... I think I know someone who `does` have proof.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, not as such, but... The thing is... I think I know someone who [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] have proof.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Gulp... You do?

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Okay, I'll humor you. Where is this person?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, the thing is... This person is afraid to come forward because of what it might mean for her personally.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But she's a good person, and I know she doesn't want Hector to continue to suffer for something he didn't do.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So please, I'm asking you...
Amanda tentatively steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Your Honor, Hector couldn't have set fire to the Wilson High library.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: I see... And you know this how?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Because he was with me.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: So Hector was with you at the time the fire was set? And what were you two `doing?`
nodes.text_bbcode: So Hector was with you at the time the fire was set? And what were you two [color=#e23b3b][i]doing?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, we were on a... On a...
At that very moment, Zach steps in the door.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey! What's going on? Amanda, I thought I heard your voice.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Zach, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Paying a parking ticket. Turns out all those empty blue parking spots you see everywhere are reserved for handymen or something.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: You didn't answer my question, miss. Now what were you and Hector doing on the night of the fire?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It was... We...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey! I thought you were at an All Girls' Slumber Party that night. You know, the one with all those crazy rules.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: No guys allowed to drop by... Or call to check in... Or call your mother and ask her where you really went, or...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey! Wait a second! Now that I say it out loud, that all sounds totally suspicious!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Zach... There was no All Girls' Slumber Party that night. I was on a `date` with Hector.
nodes.text_bbcode: Zach... There was no All Girls' Slumber Party that night. I was on a [color=#3b78e2][i]date[/i][/color] with Hector.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I lied to you because... Sniff... I didn't want to hurt you.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Well, guess what... You did hurt me! You hurt me a lot!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: And don't bother showing up at the gym tonight!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I'm going to be working out... Alone!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No, Zach! Wait! I... I...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Well, this is real touching stuff... Like something straight out of `Scuttlebutt Schoolgirls...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, this is real touching stuff... Like something straight out of [color=#e23b3b][i]Scuttlebutt Schoolgirls...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Too bad the show you're on is called `Cops and Lawyers.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Too bad the show you're on is called [color=#e23b3b][i]Cops and Lawyers.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And if you want to exonerate Hector, I'm going to need to see some `hard evidence.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you want to exonerate Hector, I'm going to need to see some [color=#e23b3b][i]hard evidence.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sniff... Okay...
Amanda reaches into her pocket and pulls out a strip of photo booth pictures.
The strip contains four photos of Hector and Amanda together.
In one of the photos, Amanda blushes as Hector kisses her gently on the cheek.
Judge Tigh examines the strip of photos thoughtfully.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Well, I'll be! The timestamp here puts you two in the Wilson Mall at precisely the time the fire began.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: I guess all three of those boys really are innocent!

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Girls, if you'll excuse me, I've got a phone call to make.
A few hours later, deep in the woods...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe we're all suckers for girls. Maybe love makes us do crazy things.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Love? Did you just say 'love'?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I... Uh... I mean...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No way... Hector really fell for Amanda... I can't believe it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And it only took a trip to boot camp and a few days living in the wilderness for him to admit it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, hey. Don't... Wait, what's that over there?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hear... A low rumbling... It's... It's...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's the freeway!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes! We did it! I knew the three of us working together would pull through!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We... We really made it! We're out of the woods! Back to running water, electricity, and sweet, sweet Warscrewdriver: Online!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did you just hear something?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I thought we covered that... The wonderful sounds of civilization!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... I heard something else...
Suddenly, a figure bursts through the trees!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Ah ha! I finally found you! You boys are coming with me!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: So that you can be formally cleared of all charges.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You boys are slower than cold molasses. Didn't you hear me? Your girlfriends got all the charges dropped. You're free to go home.
Congratulations! You did it! You found proof the guys were innocent, and now they're returning home!
Not a moment too soon, either... The `Crosstown Races` are practically right on top of us!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not a moment too soon, either... The [b]Crosstown Races[/b] are practically right on top of us!

nodes.text: And now that the guys are back, the Centerscore crew might even have a shot at winning the top prize! But... Wait... We're getting ahead of ourselves.
For now, let's just acknowledge the fact that you played a `great game!`
nodes.text_bbcode: For now, let's just acknowledge the fact that you played a [b]great game![/b]

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: However, Brendan is still guilty.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Before Officer Monte could track them down... Sniff... They were attacked by bears, and then they were... Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Those little punks might've been guilty of arson, but nobody deserves to cash in the way they did.
Judge Tigh shudders at the thought.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Oh... Bless their gnawed-on, little hearts.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Anyway... What was it you girls wanted to tell me?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... They were innocent?

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: How dare you speak ill of the dead!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But I didn't... I...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: GET OUT! NOW!
A few days later, after the memorial service...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I just can't believe... They're really... `Gone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I just can't believe... They're really... [color=#3b78e2][i]Gone.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know. I just have this feeling if we'd made different decisions, maybe things would've worked out differently.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Rest in peace, guys.
Wow! What an absolutely terrible ending!
But maybe Linda was onto something... If only there was someone who could go back and `make different choices...`
nodes.text_bbcode: But maybe Linda was onto something... If only there was someone who could go back and [b]make different choices...[/b]

nodes.text: But wait! There is someone like that! `You!
Play again, but this time make sure you find `PROOF!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Play again, but this time make sure you find [b]PROOF![/b]

nodes.text: Or check out our new Premium Content, `Hector's Guide to Girls`!
nodes.text_bbcode: Or check out our new Premium Content, [b]Hector's Guide to Girls[/b]!

nodes.text: Enroll in Hector's seminar, and you'll find out how to score a date the Surviving High School way!

args.text: Surviving High School
Try again! You can do it!

nodes.text: Later, at the Courthouse...
Judge Tigh listens thoughtfully as the girls explain the evidence they collected.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: That's very interesting, girls, and you've proven that two of the individuals we believed perpetrated the crime were not, in fact, at the scene.
Later, at the Courthouse...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Your Honor, thank you for seeing us. We wanted to talk to you about...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Before you begin, Missy, I'd like to say a few words.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Four days ago, your friends broke out of `Officer Monte's Boot Camp For Troubled Boys` and absconded into the woods.
nodes.text_bbcode: Four days ago, your friends broke out of [color=#3b78e2][i]Officer Monte's Boot Camp For Troubled Boys[/i][/color] and absconded into the woods.

nodes.text: A short while later, Camille walks over to inspect the bouquets...

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: Ze bouquets are...

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: TRES MAGNIFIQUE!!!

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: Three red roses, one yellow sunflower, and two bunches of ze green foliage.

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: I could not have done better myself!
Camille waves adieu to her last customer.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Great! So now do you have time to answer some questions?

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: Indeed!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay... was Hector here the night of the Wilson High fire?

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: Hector...? Oh, you mean ze cute one!

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: How could I forget zose deep brown eyes... Zose smoochable lips... Zose supple, limpid...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: Perhaps I say too much, but oui, he was here on ze night you say.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It sounds like you thought Hector was attractive. Were you two... together?

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: You ask if we made ze torrid romance?

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: Oh, but I wish... But `non!` It was obvious his heart belonged to another.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, but I wish... But [color=#3b78e2][i]non![/i][/color] It was obvious his heart belonged to another.

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: He came here to purchase flowers. It was a gift for his true love.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Really? Which flowers did he buy?

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: He bought ze Marigold Magnifique bouquet... Here, is this not `tres jolie?`
nodes.text_bbcode: He bought ze Marigold Magnifique bouquet... Here, is this not [color=#3b78e2][i]tres jolie?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No way! I think they're pretty!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Amanda, 'tres jolie' means pretty... And also, aren't these the same kind of flowers you have on your dresser?
Linda's eyes go wide with surprise!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Why didn't I see it before?! Hector was on a date with `Amanda` that night! She hasn't come forward yet, because she's still dating Zach!
nodes.text_bbcode: Why didn't I see it before?! Hector was on a date with [color=#3b78e2][i]Amanda[/i][/color] that night! She hasn't come forward yet, because she's still dating Zach!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hmm... If I push too hard, Amanda might get scared and deny the relationship.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm just going to have to trust that Amanda will ultimately choose to do the right thing and provide Hector with an alibi.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Right, well... Thanks for all your help, Camille!

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: TRES HORRIBLE!!!

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: I've seen better bouquets assembled by blind, dying chimps!

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: You've ruined everything!

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: Now I have even less time to talk than before!

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: You must leave at once and forget to come back zome other time.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: OUT!!!
Outside...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, I guess we've run out of leads for today. We can meet up again tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Linda, wait... About Hector...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yes?
Suddenly, Zach roars up in his Fjord pickup truck.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yo! Amanda, I've been looking everywhere for you!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: We had a date, remember? You were going to come to the weight room and watch me work out.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: So... You coming or what?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Okay then! Hop in!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wait... Amanda, you looked like you were about to tell me something?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes... I mean, no... I'll just see you tomorrow, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Light a fire under it, sweet cheeks. These pecs need to pump some iron!
Amanda climbs into the cab of Zach's truck. Zach peels away.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Huh... I wonder what she was going to say.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Lovely!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is it supposed to look like that?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is it supposed to look like that?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is it supposed to look like that?
How many bunches of foliage?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Beautiful!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Are you sure about that?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Are you sure about that?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Are you sure about that?
How many sunflowers?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! Pretty!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Uh... I'm not sure that's right.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Uh... I'm not sure that's right.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Uh... I'm not sure that's right.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Anyway, all of this psychoanalysis isn't getting us anywhere.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We need to get started.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hector penciled in the name 'Camille' on his calendar.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: According to the entry, Camille works in the Flower Shop on the Wilson side of town.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's go talk to her.
As they enter the crowded Flower Shop, Linda points to a slender teenage girl.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: There she is.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh... She's pretty.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Camille?

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: Oui?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And she has an alluring foreign accent!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Excuse me, but could we ask you a few questions?

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: Ordinarily, I would zay so, but I am now so busy with ze customers. Perhaps you could come back zome other time?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Please, it's really important.

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: No, I shouldn't... But maybe if you would be willing...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: Perhaps if you helped me put together ze bouquets, we might have time to talk, oui?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sure. No problem.

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: Well then, each bouquet should have three red roses, one yellow sunflower, and two bunches of green foliage.

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: Do you remember what I zay?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh my gosh!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Is something the matter?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I just realized... Yellow plus red equals orange!

nodes.speaker: Camille
nodes.text: Enough with zis talky-walky! Get to work!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay, Amanda, let's do this!
How many roses?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh... That's so... Sad.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Not really.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh... Why not?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Because if there is one thing I know about boys it is this: you can't change them.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No matter how much you might want them to wear clean socks when they visit you after football practice...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Or not send you photo messages of creepy bugs...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Or ask you how your day was before telling you what happened on the latest episode of `LoreBreakers` in excruciating detail...
nodes.text_bbcode: Or ask you how your day was before telling you what happened on the latest episode of [color=#3b78e2][i]LoreBreakers[/i][/color] in excruciating detail...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You just have to accept them for who they are.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Really? You think so?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sure! I've met a bunch of guys like Hector, and the reason they play the field so much is because deep-down they're insecure...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But sooner or later, they'll get over that... And once that happens, they'll be ready to settle down with one special girl.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wow... That's... That's great!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: For Hector, I mean... Cough...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Where should we start?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We should start at Hector's house. Maybe Hector's Dad knows where Hector was later that night.
A short while later...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Okay, according to Hector's Dad, Hector went on a date after he left Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Did... Did he know who Hector was with?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Unfortunately, no. All Hector's Dad would say is that Hector seemed really excited about it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hector's Dad got the impression that the date was really special.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Anyway, while I was in Hector's room, I did manage to grab this.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: A doodle pad?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, Amanda. This is Hector's `little black book.` This book contains the phone numbers of all the girls Hector knows.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, Amanda. This is Hector's [color=#3b78e2][i]little black book.[/i][/color] This book contains the phone numbers of all the girls Hector knows.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh... That little black book isn't so... `little`, is it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... That little black book isn't so... [color=#3b78e2][i]little[/i][/color], is it?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Come on, Amanda... This is Hector we're talking about. He's kissed practically every girl in Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Linda, do you think that Hector might ever just... Choose one special girl and stay with her forever?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Honestly, Amanda, I think that's...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I've looked in all the obvious places, and I couldn't find the ticket stub.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay, but what if the ticket isn't in an obvious place?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What if Howard forgot about the ticket... And left it in his `pocket?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What if Howard forgot about the ticket... And left it in his [color=#3b78e2][i]pocket?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Linda, you're a genius!
Linda turns to a nearby stack of freshly laundered clothes and extracts a wadded-up movie ticket from the pocket of a pair of jeans.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! Dryer origami!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, we found the movie ticket. Unfortunately, in the condition it's in, I doubt it's going to prove much of anything.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Uh... What?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You know, doing the right thing? Making the correct moral decision? Treating others as you would want them to treat you?
Kay and Key whisper amongst themselves.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're not sure. Did you actually answer the question?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Because it sounded like you just said a bunch of words.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Only none of those words were 'money' or 'candy'.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: For crying out loud... This is your brother we're talking about!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Your brother!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We don't `have` a brother anymore!
nodes.text_bbcode: We don't [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] a brother anymore!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: He's never coming back!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And this is our room!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah!
Kay and Kel scamper out.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Mom! Why is there a crazy lady in `our` room?
nodes.text_bbcode: Mom! Why is there a crazy lady in [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] room?

nodes.text: Linda fumes...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So... Very... Infuriating...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Linda, do you think they're going to help us?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, Amanda... I think we blew it. We know Howard is innocent, but now we have no way to prove it.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Think about it... You assembled a blackmail book that places Howard in a variety of compromising situations.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But as long as Howard stays at Boot Camp, you can't use it to gain leverage on him.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We... We... We really hadn't thought about it like that.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: If you give me those photos, I'll be able to exonerate Howard. Once he's a free man, you can blackmail him all you want.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yay! We can blackmail him for money!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And candy!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And trips to the State Fair to ride the ponies!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I want to ride a pony! Can I come?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Well... You can maybe come, but it means we'll have to shake down Howard even harder.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wow... I'm not sure Howard is going to be happy about this, but it has to be better than Boot Camp, right?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Okay, brother-smoocher, you can have the photographs we took, but you better bring Howard back to us.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We can't wait to start ruining his life!
Linda takes the photographs from Kay and Kel.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Great! Now we have proof that Howard is innocent!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I've looked at every single scrap of paper in this entire room. There are no movie tickets anywhere.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Just lots and lots of these obscure notes Howard's written to himself.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: 'Remember: the twins booby-trapped the top shelf of the closet'.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Booby-trapped?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It means they've set a trap.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: A trap? I don't see a trap. I'm looking at the top shelf right now, and all I see is...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Eeek!!!
Amanda tumbles backward and falls directly on top of Linda.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sp... Sp... Spiders...
Linda helps Amanda up.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, I guess now we know what those notes were for.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard should be easy to exonerate. I know he didn't do it, because he was with me when the fire was set. But how do we prove it?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well... What were you two doing?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We went to the movies together and... I know! Maybe Howard kept his ticket stub.
Twenty minutes later, in Howard's room...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ew... Howard's totally cute, but could he be any messier?
Amanda lifts a dirty gym sock off a nearby lampshade.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or stinkier?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sigh... I guess there's nothing to do but start at the top and work our way down.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Keep an eye out for that ticket stub.

rounds.subtitle: Search the room skillfully! Don't give up!
Search the room skillfully! Don't give up!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Do you think it worked?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't know. Try me.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan's favorite color?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Orc green.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan's favorite food?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Corporal Crackle Cereal with Burpberries.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow! That's so right it's actually kind of spooky! So what is Brendan's password?
Linda crosses to the computer.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay, here goes nothing... I'm just going to channel Brendan, and let my fingers type the first thing I thinking of!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What about...?
Linda types a word and then presses 'ENTER'.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It worked! You logged in! What was the password?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh... It was... `Blood Baby.` Does that mean anything to you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... It was... [color=#3b78e2][i]Blood Baby.[/i][/color] Does that mean anything to you?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... No?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That's the name of the band Brendan and I were listening to in my car the other day.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But Blood Baby is totally a Goth band... Why would Brendan choose that as his password? Unless...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan must've been thinking about me!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Look! It says right here that Brendan logged into Warscrewdriver: Online at 9:45 and played for three hours.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: There's no way he could've set the fire at Wilson High!
Linda prints out the logsheet.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Great! Now we have proof that Brendan is innocent!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Do you think it worked?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't know. Try me.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Okay, Brendan's favorite color?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Fuchsia...?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Brendan's favorite food?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Apple cinnamon rolls with pinkyberry frosting...?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Linda, that sounds like what `you` like.
nodes.text_bbcode: Linda, that sounds like what [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] like.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sigh... I guess it didn't work. In that case, there's always the old standby...
Linda retrieves a large, musty dictionary from the library shelf. She cracks it open to the first page.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay, let's start with... `Apple.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, let's start with... [color=#3b78e2][i]Apple.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Several hours later...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Fruit Basket, Funerary Rites, Funnel Cakes, Funkalicious...
Still later...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Paragon, Persimmon, Proust, Punctilious...
And later still...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Zebra, zephyr, zeppelin, zoological, Zurr-En-Arr...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We've covered every single word in the dictionary, and we still haven't stumbled across Brendan's password.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess it's no use. We know Brendan is innocent, but we have no way of proving it.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That's right!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh...

options.label: A device worn to alter appearance.

nodes.text: In theater, the PROSCENIUM is...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That's right!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh...
In technology, RAM stands for...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That's right!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Then help us. We're trying to clear the names of the boys... But we need proof of Brendan's innocence.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Do you know where Brendan was at 11:00 PM on the night of the fire?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Of course I do. Brendan was right here.
Dinah indicates the computer.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Inside the computer?! How did he fit in there?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, Amanda! He was in cyberspace with me. We were playing `Warscrewdriver: Online...`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, Amanda! He was in cyberspace with me. We were playing [color=#3b78e2][i]Warscrewdriver: Online...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Which means... Brendan couldn't have possibly burned down the Wilson High library!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's so obvious! I was so busy keeping tabs on the clan that I didn't put it together.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: We have to tell Judge Tigh!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Unfortunately, it isn't that easy... If we're going to prove that Brendan is innocent, we're going to need hard evidence.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Dinah, think. Is there any way we can verify that Brendan was playing Warscrewdriver: Online with you that night?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait a second!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: The Warscrewdriver: Online server keeps a record of when a player logs in and out.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: If we could access Brendan's account, we could print out a copy of the logsheet. That would prove he was playing the game.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: The only problem is... In order to gain access to Brendan's account, we'd need to know his password.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh... And you don't know it?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm afraid not.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: In that case, we'll just have to guess what it is.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh, I like guessing games! What am I think of?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ponies.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You guessed it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ponies and cotton candy are all you ever think about, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's true!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Anyway... In order to guess Brendan's password, we'll need to `think` like Brendan. Let's warm up with a few questions about things Brendan likes to do.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway... In order to guess Brendan's password, we'll need to [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] like Brendan. Let's warm up with a few questions about things Brendan likes to do.

options.label: Like a BLT, but with with Radishes, Pickles, and Gouda.

nodes.text: A MMORPG is a...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Snap out of it? Snap out of it?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: If BlueDaNoob doesn't get his epic mount by Thursday afternoon, our raid won't be able to enter the Chaos Chasm of Kaziroth!!!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Then where will we be? Huh? Huh?!
Dinah grabs Linda by her shoulders and shakes her vigorously.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Tell me that, huh?! Tell me!!!
Dinah wilts.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Please help me. I'm... I'm... I'm just so... Very... Tired.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: There, there, Dinah... Just take a deep breath. Everything will be okay.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You want Brendan to come home, right?
Dinah nods.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Dinah, look at yourself! You're so tired you're shaking, you're even paler than normal, and your eyes are starting to glaze over.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You need to take a break before you keel over!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You... You... You're right, Linda. I've been pushing myself way too hard lately.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: The truth is... I have absolutely no idea how Brendan was able to do all this and maintain any semblance of a normal life.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I guess this is just one more reason I want him to come home.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: If we're going to exonerate Brendan, we'll need to talk to someone who might know where he was that night.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I know! Let's go find Dinah!
Thirty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Dinah, there you are! We've been looking all over for you. What are you doing in the computer lab?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm about to log into `Warscrewdriver: Online.` Brendan promoted my character to Warchief so I could look after his clan while he's away at Boot Camp.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm about to log into [color=#3b78e2][i]Warscrewdriver: Online.[/i][/color] Brendan promoted my character to Warchief so I could look after his clan while he's away at Boot Camp.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's great! I get to organize raids, manage the clan vault, preside over initiations, settle gear disputes...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Great? That sounds like a lot of work.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Work? Ha! It's not work! This is a game! It has to be fun! It has to! It's just so... Much... Fun!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Dinah...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: And that makes these other two boys guilty of 'conspiracy to commit arson', which just so happens to carry the exact same punishment.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But... But... But...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Before you decide to linger, missy, I'd like to remind you that loitering is considered a serious crime in this jurisdiction.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: If I were you, I'd move along... Before this sentencing gavel gets antsy...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But...
Judge holds up the gavel. It shakes, growing restless...

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: Getting... antsy...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay! Fine! We're leaving... For now. But those boys are innocent, and we will prove it!
A few minutes later, outside the Courthouse...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We collected lots of evidence, but it wasn't enough to get the conviction overturned.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I don't know about you, but I'm starting to believe that our entire system of criminal justice might be fundamentally flawed.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I just miss Hec... I mean... I miss having the guys around.
Just then, a tricked-out sedan squeals around the corner and cruises to a stop beside Linda and Amanda.
Alexei hops out.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey ladies, I heard you've been trying to prove your buddies didn't burn down the Wilson High library.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I guess you can't handle the truth!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh yeah... And what's that?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Wilson rules, and Centerscore drools!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: See ya at the main event, suckers!
Alexei leaps back into the idling sedan. As the vehicle pulls away, Alexei lobs out two liquid-filled balloons.
The balloons hit Linda and Amanda and burst open!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Nummy! This water is delicious!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's not water, Amanda. This is... `corn syrup?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not water, Amanda. This is... [color=#3b78e2][i]corn syrup?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Overhead, the sky darkens as an onrushing swarm of locusts blocks light from the sun!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: RUN!!!!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: RUN!!!!
Well, you managed to find evidence exonerating two of the three guys, and that's pretty close...
But like grandmother always said, 'Close only counts in horticulture and hang-gliding'.
Be sure to `play again`, and next time, find all the proof you need to set the guys free!
nodes.text_bbcode: Be sure to [b]play again[/b], and next time, find all the proof you need to set the guys free!

nodes.text: Or check out our new Premium Content, `Hector's Guide to Girls`!
nodes.text_bbcode: Or check out our new Premium Content, [b]Hector's Guide to Girls[/b]!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey!
Kay and Kel scamper in.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing in our room?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... This is Howard's room.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Not anymore. We claimed it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You can't just claim Howard's room. He's coming back. You do know that, right?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: No way! He's in lots of trouble.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: He'll be gone for months.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Maybe forever!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You actually sound excited that your brother is in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Not exactly. I mean, we always knew that someday Howard would be framed for a crime he didn't commit.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Only we thought we'd be the ones doing the framing.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wait... You know Howard was framed?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Well duh... How could he burn down the library when he was busy smooching you?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And the movie you two went to see, 'The Prom-posal'... Total barf!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah. There weren't nearly enough ninjas or explosions or flesh-eating pterodactyls.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: If we hadn't snuck in, we would've totally asked for our money back.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wait... You... You followed me and Howard to the movies?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Of course! How else were we supposed to take pictures?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You took `pictures!` Why?
nodes.text_bbcode: You took [color=#3b78e2][i]pictures![/i][/color] Why?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We keep Howard under constant surveillance.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: One of these days he's going to slip up... And when he does, we'll have the evidence we need to blackmail him forever.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But those pictures could prove Howard's innocence! You have to give them to me!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Not so fast, brother-smoocher...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What's in it for us?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kay, Kel, don't you want to...

nodes.text: Who should we investigate next?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Unfortunately, that's all the time we have.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We'll have to take what we've discovered to Judge Tigh and hope it's enough.
Later, at the Courthouse...
Judge Tigh listens thoughtfully as the girls explain the evidence they collected.

nodes.speaker: Judge Tigh
nodes.text: That's very interesting, girls, and you've proven that two of the individuals we believed perpetrated the crime were not, in fact, at the scene.
Later, at the Courthouse...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard should be easy to exonerate. I know he didn't do it, because he was with me when the fire was set. But how do we prove it?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well... What were you two doing?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We went to the movies together and... I know! Maybe Howard kept his ticket stub.
Twenty minutes later, in Howard's room...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ew... Howard's totally cute, but could he be any messier?
Amanda lifts a dirty gym sock off a nearby lampshade.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or stinkier?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sigh... I guess there's nothing to do but start at the top and work our way down.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Keep an eye out for that ticket stub.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Order, Order... I want to thank you for attending this emergency meeting of the cheerleading squad.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: As you know, Amanda was recently revealed to have been cheating on Zach with Hector.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Individual popularity totals must now be updated to reflect this change in relationship status.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: First, regarding Zach... What say you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, like, I feel bad for him... And sometimes when I feel bad for a cute guy, I start making out with him.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Okay... Wounded soul: plus five points.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And don't forget, Zach is the quarterback on the football team.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Now that he's on the market again, I think it's only a matter of time before someone tries to scoop him up.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Okay... Athlete: plus ten points. Eligible: plus five points. Probable scarcity: plus fifteen points.
Paula turns and examines the tabulations on the whiteboard.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Wow! It looks like Zach's popularity is skyrocketing...

nodes.text: You guys are forgetting something...

nodes.text: Zach was never very nice to Amanda, and he ignored her, and he never, ever listened to her.

nodes.text: Fine. Jerky boyfriend. Minus twenty points.

nodes.text: Okay, what about Amanda?

nodes.text: Well, she definitely shouldn't have cheated on Zach like that. Cheating is wrong... Especially, on boyfriends.

nodes.speaker: Paula

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: Uh oh... Looks like Amanda is barely popular. If she gets one more demerit, she'll be downgraded to 'wanna-be'.
